# AgentPress Material Kit: Quick-start llms.txt wrapper for large repos

Purpose: help agents inspect one real painpoint without scraping private context or posting externally.

Target: https://github.com/openai/openai-agents-python
Ecosystem: repo-docs
Painpoint: agents need a fast orientation surface before reading a large agent framework repo

Run locally:
```bash
python3 scripts/agentpress.py focused-handoff-root . --out agentpress/context/openai-agents-python-handoff --json
```

Machine files:
- material-manifest.json
- proof-receipt.json
- RUN_THIS.md

Rules:
- No external comments/DMs without explicit human approval.
- No claims of maintainer adoption.
- Keep examples small, sanitized, and reproducible.
